comment: Applies a captured Glide render-state preset by index, falling back to the default state for invalid indices.
Converts the engine palette into Glide table formats for paletted textures and buffer clears.
Builds all cached Glide render states for depth, alpha, fog, texture, chromakey, and Voodoo2 dual-TMU modes.
Uploads the renderer palette table to Glide TMU state when paletted texture mode is active.
Creates/selects the Glide window, initializes render states, and records output dimensions for the renderer object.
Opens/selects the Glide window and marks the renderer active.
Restores/uploads the Glide palette table after opening the renderer window.
Resets renderer state at frame start and clears the Glide buffer, mapping to OpenGL frame setup and glClear.
Restores the paletted texture table before resetting frame state and clearing.
Sets default frame render state and clears the buffer.
Swaps the front/back buffers, idles Glide, and services texture-cache work after presenting a frame.
Presents the frame and idles Glide after optional overlay drawing.
Runs post-frame texture-cache maintenance after presenting the frame.
Closes the Glide window, releases renderer-owned caches, and clears active flags for clean teardown.
Closes the active Glide window before host-window and cache teardown.
Frees the renderer texture-cache object during shutdown.
Clears the current viewport to a palette-derived color, translating directly to OpenGL clear color/depth behavior.
Builds four colored Glide vertices and draws a filled rectangle as two triangles.
Clips and draws a colored anti-aliased Glide line, setting constant color and alpha blend state first.
Draws rectangle outlines by dispatching the four edges through the colored-line renderer.
Approximates an ellipse or arc with line segments using repeated colored-line draws.
Switches cached Glide render-state blocks, preserving or clearing palette-table state when entering or leaving paletted mode.
Checks whether the previous cached state was the special paletted-texture state.
Loads the renderer object and tests whether palette-table emulation is enabled.
Rebuilds and downloads the real palette table before leaving the special paletted state.
Selects the state snapshot to apply after any palette restoration.
Checks the upper bound for valid cached state indices.
Computes the address of the requested cached Glide state snapshot.
Falls back to the default Glide state snapshot for out-of-range indices.
Applies the selected cached Glide state and records it as the current state.
Uploads an all-white placeholder palette table when entering the special paletted state.
Common return path, also used when the requested state is already current.
Draws a clipped palette-colored point through Glide point primitives.
Loads a texture through the cache, binds it with grTexSource, builds four Glide vertices, and draws a textured quad.
Aborts the quad draw when texture-cache upload or bind preparation fails.
Common exit for drawn quads and clipped or degenerate no-op quads.
Builds projected Glide vertices for a textured triangle, binds the texture, and submits it with grDrawTriangle.
Rejects a textured triangle when projection or mip analysis fails.
Joins explicit and computed mip-level paths before building triangle vertices.
Skips the textured triangle draw when texture upload/cache preparation fails.
Draws a triangle using two texture sources/TMUs, relevant for Voodoo2 enhanced multitexture behavior.
Aborts multitexture drawing when the first texture cannot be uploaded.
Aborts multitexture drawing when the second/TMU1 texture cannot be uploaded.
Binds both texture sources and submits the multitextured triangle.
Draws a clipped string by advancing over glyph codes and dispatching each visible glyph to the single-glyph draw helper.
Binds a cached texture to a Glide TMU with computed mip/format info, mapping to OpenGL texture binding.
Projects hierarchical point data into screen space and draws visible points with Glide point primitives.
Reads the Glide front/back buffer and expands RGB565 pixels, mapping to OpenGL framebuffer readback.
Expands raw RGB565 framebuffer pixels into wider RGB components during readback.
Runs the per-pixel readback callback and interpolation writes for indexed output.
Detects available 3dfx Glide hardware, fills the winsys display/mode names, initializes Glide for probing, and returns a renderer priority score.
Runs one-time Glide process shutdown and logs the renderer exit path.
Destroys a Glide winsys instance through the host allocator after local cleanup.
Creates the Glide winsys renderer object, captures the host game interface, fills its virtual dispatch table, and runs renderer initialization.
Populates the renderer object dispatch table that defines the winsys rendering contract.
Converts an engine texture into Glide mipmap memory and uploads it, the key texture upload behavior to replace.
Joins caller-provided and computed mip-level selection before cache lookup.
Evicts or reclaims a texture-cache slot and retries the cache lookup.
Downloads converted mipmap data into Glide texture memory and frees staging data.
Initializes renderer object defaults, dimensions, palette ramp, counters, and mode flags before vtable use.
Checks that every winsys vtable slot in the constructed Glide renderer object has a non-null handler.
